response:
It's touching that you want to thank your counselor—it clearly meant a lot to have his support during such a hard transition.

That said, gifts to counselors can be tricky. Many universities have policies limiting whether counselors can accept gifts, especially alcohol, since it can create boundary or ethical concerns regardless of intent. Wine in particular can be complicated. A safer choice might be something meaningful but non-alcoholic that represents your country, or simply a heartfelt thank-you card or note describing how much his help meant to you. Honestly, sincere words often mean more than any object.

If you'd still like to give something, you could ask him directly whether he's allowed to accept a small token—that way you avoid putting him in an awkward position. Enjoy your vacation, and be proud of how far you've come this semester.
